// Pipe placeholder and the extraction chains it may head on the right-hand side of
    // `|>` (R >= 4.3: `_$coef`, `_$coef[[2]]`, `_[["x"]]`, `_@slot`).
    _placeholder: $ => alias("_", $.identifier),

    _placeholder_chain: $ => choice(
      alias($._placeholder_extract, $.extract_operator),
      alias($._placeholder_subset, $.subset),
      alias($._placeholder_subset2, $.subset2)
    ),

    _placeholder_head: $ => choice($._placeholder, $._placeholder_chain),

    _placeholder_extract: $ => withPrec(PREC.EXTRACT, seq(
      field("lhs", $._placeholder_head),
      field("operator", choice("$", "@")),
      repeat($._newline),
      field("rhs", $._string_or_identifier)
    )),

    _placeholder_subset: $ => withPrec(PREC.CALL, seq(
      field("function", $._placeholder_head),
      field("arguments", alias($.subset_arguments, $.arguments))
    )),

    _placeholder_subset2: $ => withPrec(PREC.CALL, seq(
      field("function", $._placeholder_head),
      field("arguments", alias($.subset2_arguments, $.arguments))
    )),

    // Expressions that bind at least as tightly as a call: the only possible heads of
    // `call`, `subset`, `subset2` and `$`/`@`. Lower-precedence forms (operators,
    // function definitions, control flow) can never be a head, so listing them would
    // only add LR conflicts; the rank lets a head win over ending an expression.
    _primary: $ => prec(PREC.CALL.RANK, choice(
      $.braced_expression,
      $.parenthesized_expression,
      $.call,
      $.subset,
      $.subset2,
      $.extract_operator,
      $.namespace_operator,
      $.integer,
      $.complex,
      $.float,
      $.string,
      $.identifier,
      $.dots,
      $.dot_dot_i,
      $.next,
      $.break,
      $.true,
      $.false,
      $.null,
      $.inf,
      $.nan,
      $.na
    )),
